title: Whisper Client
requirements: Implement WhisperClient as actor with init(apiKey: String)
Use URLSession with 120s timeout, HTTPS only
transcribe(at audioURL: URL) async throws -> Transcript
Never log API key or audio contents
acceptance_criteria: Returns Transcript with source .whisper on success
Throws whisperError(status) on non-2xx HTTP response
API key is never included in logs or error messages
